title: eludite.git.log input
description: The history (Git Repository window, View History): commits from `revision` (default HEAD; `all` for every branch, remote branch and tag), newest first in topological order, with the graph's lanes, author, date, summary and refs. Bounded by `max` and cancelable; `skip` pages. The repository is the one discovered from the open workspace (solution folder or opened folder) upward, as `git` discovers it; without one the command fails naming eludite.git.init.

revision.description: Where to start: a branch, `HEAD~3`, a commit id. Default HEAD.

all.description: Every local branch, remote branch and tag (the Git Repository window's graph). Default false.

path.description: Only commits that change this file (relative to the repository root).
